title: Code 430 emergency services v0
description: Optional file in a map pack. Police stations, security desks, hospitals, fire stations, ambulance posts and helipads with a position, the nearest road node and, where known, a street address.

address.description: Street address from OSM addr:* tags (the place's own, or the building it stands in), or "on <street>" for the nearest named road when the data has none. Optional (add-map-legend).
